mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.member_id AS memberId, o.status, o.ordered_at AS orderedAt, o.name AS receiverName, o.phone_number AS receiverPhoneNumber, o.zip_code AS zipCode, o.main_address AS mainAddress, o.detail_address AS detailAddress, oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, p.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, pi.image_url AS productThumbnailImageUrl, oi.price, oi.quantity, oi.price * oi.quantity AS itemTotalPrice FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN product_images pi ON pi.product_id = p.product_id AND pi.is_thumbnail = true WHERE o.order_id = #{orderIdValue} ORDER BY oi.order_item_id
